import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
print(w.work_id.duplicated().sum(), w.year.isna().sum(), w[c].value_counts())
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']);w['late']=w.year>=1876;w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
t=w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack();print(t)
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack();return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for col in ['date_confidence','origin']:
  for v,d in w.groupby(col): print(col,v,est(d), len(d))
print('high+med',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']))
print('ed1',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
pp=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))].merge(w[['work_id','year','genre']],on='work_id')
print(pp.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).head(10)[['passage_id','year','genre','technology_named','confidence']])
"
